checks.name: Receipt posts balance, ledger, operation and outbox
NULL lot and serial do not create duplicate balance identities
Concurrent balance identity creation returns one ID
Partial reservation release preserves physical stock
Cannot reserve more than available stock
Cannot reserve beyond unfulfilled order quantity
Identical retry returns original result despite stale expected version
Same command ID with changed payload is rejected
Changed actor cannot replay or read another actor command result
Stale document version is rejected for a new command
Free transfer debits and credits atomically
Picking relocates reservation without fulfilling the shipment
Issue consumes reservation and increases fulfillment
Free transfer cannot steal reserved stock
Failure after balance changes rolls back all effects
Exact fractional quantities obey item scale without silent rounding
Reject quantity 0
Reject quantity -1
Reject quantity NaN
Reject quantity Infinity
Reject quantity 0.0000001
Quarantine stock is visible but not allocatable
A serial has one live location and can be transferred
Lot-tracked item requires a lot
Serial cannot be paired with a different lot
Composite foreign keys reject cross-organization stock identity
Reservation cannot use another item
Incomplete operation cannot commit
Posted movement history rejects updates
Runtime cannot write balances or invoke private helpers
Module read role cannot call posting functions or mutate core
Module writes its own storage while decisions remain append-only
Expired reservation blocks new issue, supports replay and explicit expiry release
Concurrent reservations of the last stock cannot oversell
Concurrent identical commands post once
Opposite-direction transfers use consistent lock order
Prepare and post share a transaction; retry bypasses stale guard snapshot
Prepared command cannot commit without posting
Guard denial rolls back prepared operation before stock posting
Outbox envelope follows published contract and accompanies every completed command
All balances and document reservations reconcile with durable history

scope: Isolated PostgreSQL integration checks; no load, HA, crash durability or application authorization verification.
